description: Figure 3, titled "The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies," is a bar chart that displays the frequency of various types of input stimuli. The horizontal axis represents the different types of stimulus materials, which are categorized as "Text," "Image," "Video," "Audio," and "Other." The vertical axis is labeled "Count," indicating the number of times each stimulus type was used. The chart shows that "Text" is the most frequently used stimulus type, with a count of approximately 50. "Image" follows with a count of about 10, while "Video," "Audio," and "Other" have much lower counts, each appearing to be less than 5. The chart uses two different shades of green to represent the two news agencies, with the legend indicating that the lighter green bar corresponds to Agency A and the darker green bar to Agency B. The data for Agency A is consistently higher than that for Agency B across all stimulus types.
